title: Transformer Architecture — Alternate Group Discussion and Desk Work
key_insight: A transformer block alternates attention, which mixes information across positions, with a feed-forward network, which transforms each position.
body:
## Alternate Group Discussion and Desk Work

Every word first needs to hear relevant words, then privately update what it understands. Repeating only one of those activities is limiting.

A transformer block alternates attention, which mixes information across positions, with a feed-forward network, which transforms each position.

Many blocks build progressively richer representations. Residual paths and normalization keep the deep stack trainable.
common_mistakes: A transformer contains attention and nothing else.
Decoder generation should read future unseen tokens.
A key-value cache makes memory use shrink as context grows.
mini_exercise: Draw “Alternate Group Discussion and Desk Work” as three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: Transformers are the architecture behind modern language models and many vision and multimodal systems.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Alternate Group Discussion and Desk Work,” explain Transformer Architecture without assuming the listener knows modern AI.
